description.content:
Retrieves a list of swaps (DEX trades) based on various query filters.

**Rate Limit**: This endpoint has a stricter rate limit of 1 request per second.

query.description: (Required) Filter by specific entity or address involved in the swap. Required — omitting it returns an empty list.
(Required) Filter by specific entity or address involved in the swap. Required — omitting it returns an empty list.
Chains to filter by, as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,solana'). If omitted, returns data across all supported chains.
Chains to filter by, as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,solana'). If omitted, returns data across all supported chains.
Swap direction relative to the base address. Valid values: 'in' (receiving token1), 'out' (sending token0), or 'all'. Defaults to 'all'.
List of token addresses or token IDs that appear as either token0 or token1.
List of token addresses or token IDs that appear as either token0 or token1.

Filter to swaps where the base sold one of these tokens (token addresses or token IDs). Combine with 'to' for a specific sold/bought trade. To match a token on either side regardless of direction use 'tokens'; to filter by the transaction parties instead, use senders/receivers.

Filter to swaps where the base sold one of these tokens (token addresses or token IDs). Combine with 'to' for a specific sold/bought trade. To match a token on either side regardless of direction use 'tokens'; to filter by the transaction parties instead, use senders/receivers.
Filter to swaps where the base bought one of these tokens (token addresses or token IDs). Combine with 'from' for a specific sold/bought trade.
Filter to swaps where the base bought one of these tokens (token addresses or token IDs). Combine with 'from' for a specific sold/bought trade.
Filter swaps at or after this time (unix ms, unix seconds, RFC3339, or YYYY-MM-DD).
Filter swaps at or before this time (unix ms, unix seconds, RFC3339, or YYYY-MM-DD).
Time range filter using relative durations (e.g. 24h, 7d). Cannot be combined with timeGte/timeLte.
Field by which to sort the results. One of: time, usd.
Sort direction: 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'desc'.
Maximum number of results to return. Default: 20. Max: 1649.
Pagination offset. offset + limit must not exceed 10000.
List of addresses or entities to treat strictly as counterparties.
List of addresses or entities to treat strictly as counterparties.
Filter by the transaction parties that initiated the swap (sender addresses or entities). Distinct from 'from', which filters on the sold token.
Filter by the transaction parties that initiated the swap (sender addresses or entities). Distinct from 'from', which filters on the sold token.
Filter by the transaction parties that received the swap output (receiver addresses or entities). Distinct from 'to', which filters on the bought token.
Filter by the transaction parties that received the swap output (receiver addresses or entities). Distinct from 'to', which filters on the bought token.
Filter by protocol/DEX addresses or entity IDs.
Filter by protocol/DEX addresses or entity IDs.
